claims.claim: GlobalFoundries signed a $2 billion agreement to supply TSMC with U.S.-based silicon interposers and will expand its Malta, New York campus.
claims.episode_span: GlobalFoundries has signed a $2 billion agreement to supply TSMC with U.S.-made silicon interposers
claims.source_title: GlobalFoundries Reaches Supply Agreement with TSMC for AI Chip Component
claims.supporting_quote: GlobalFoundries signed a $2 billion agreement to supply TSMC with U.S.-based silicon interposers, a key component of semiconductor chips used for AI.

claims.claim: The GlobalFoundries-TSMC interposer contract is an initial five-year deal, with volume production at Malta scheduled for the first half of 2028, and the parts include embedded deep trench capacitors.
claims.episode_span: Volume production and the capacity ramp at the New York site are scheduled to begin in the first half of 2028
claims.source_title: GlobalFoundries and TSMC Partner on US Interposer Production for CoWoS
claims.supporting_quote: Volume production and capacity ramp-up at the New York site are scheduled to begin during the first half of 2028.

claims.claim: Xsight Labs announced the Arm-based E1L DPU with full offload from 25 watts, support for up to 200G, and the same open software as the 800G E1.
claims.episode_span: The part is Arm-based and is described as delivering full DPU offload from 25 watts
claims.source_title: Xsight Labs Adds E1L to DPU Portfolio with Support for up to 200G
claims.supporting_quote: Arm-based E1L delivers full DPU offload from 25 watts, on the same open software as the 800G E1

claims.claim: GF Securities analyst Jeff Pu said Nvidia could adopt Intel Foveros for select AI-chip backend work in the second half of 2028, when Intel 14A is expected to enter mass production.
claims.episode_span: Nvidia could adopt Intel's Foveros packaging for backend work on select AI chips in the second half of 2028
claims.source_title: Intel's Packaging Technology Gains Nvidia's Interest, Easing Pressure on TSMC's Backend Operations
claims.supporting_quote: GF Securities analyst Jeff Pu noted in a recent report that with Intel's 14A chip manufacturing technology expected to enter mass production in the second half of 2028, Nvidia could adopt Intel's Foveros chip packaging technology around the same period to meet its backend needs.

claims.claim: ThisWay Global says it completed acquisition of a bankrupt RELLIS data-center project on September 30, 2026, and plans a 73 MW center on about 25 acres in Bryan, Texas.
claims.episode_span: ThisWay Global has announced a 73 MW Research and AI Compute Center in Bryan, Texas
claims.source_title: ThisWay Global to Convert Bankrupt RELLIS Site into 73 MW AI Hub
claims.supporting_quote: TWG plans a phased Research and AI Compute Center (RACC) totaling 73 MW on about 25 acres of TAMUS land.

claims.claim: Frore says LiquidJet Diamond raises tokens per watt by 35 percent versus skived coldplates, after LiquidJet's 12 degree Celsius and 25 percent gain and an additional 10 degree Celsius hotspot reduction.
claims.episode_span: The company says it boosts AI tokens per watt, and revenue, by 35 percent versus traditional skived coldplates
claims.source_title: Frore Systems Announces New LiquidJet Diamond Coldplates for AI Factories
claims.supporting_quote: LiquidJet Diamond Coldplate boosts AI Tokens/Watt and revenue by 35% compared to traditional skived coldplates, with the increased revenue flowing directly to profit.

claims.claim: CoreWeave said it is working with AdaniConneX on a first India presence, will deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin, and will open a local office and hire.
claims.episode_span: CoreWeave has announced a first presence in India with AdaniConneX
claims.source_title: CoreWeave CEO on Fox Business: Expanding to India with AdaniConneX
claims.supporting_quote: $CRWV CEO Michael Intrator joined @FoxBusiness to explain why we're working with AdaniConneX on our first presence in India.

claims.claim: Cantor Fitzgerald and Mirae Asset said fears of memory capacity excess and HBM price cuts after Toshiba capacity-expansion news were overblown.
claims.episode_span: Cantor Fitzgerald and Mirae Asset said fears of capacity excess and of HBM price cuts were overblown
claims.source_title: Memory Stocks Rebound Across the Board as Micron, SanDisk and SK Hynix Gain Over 2%
claims.supporting_quote: Multiple brokerages, including Cantor Fitzgerald and Mirae Asset, released reports stating that market fears over capacity excess and HBM price cuts were clearly overblown.

claims.claim: On October 8, 2026, Oak Ridge was selected for six Phase II Genesis Mission awards spanning materials, microelectronics, quantum, accelerator operations, HPC software, and fusion.
claims.episode_span: Oak Ridge National Laboratory was selected for six Phase II Genesis Mission awards
claims.source_title: ORNL Selected for 6 Phase II Genesis Mission Awards
claims.supporting_quote: The Department of Energy’s (DOE) Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) has been selected for six Phase II awards under the DOE’s Genesis Mission.

claims.claim: IDC preliminary data cited by TechPowerUp put Q3 2026 worldwide PC shipments at 62.7 million units, down 20.1 percent from 78.5 million a year earlier and 9.1 percent from the prior quarter.
claims.episode_span: worldwide PC shipments at 62.7 million units in the third quarter of 2026, down 20.1 percent from 78.5 million
claims.source_title: PC Shipments Drop 20.1% in Q3 2026, HP and Dell Hit Hardest
claims.supporting_quote: Worldwide PC shipments fell a steep 20.1% year over year in Q3 2026 to 62.7 million units, according to preliminary data from IDC , down from 78.5 million in the same quarter last year.
